**How to protect an internal admin tool: good, better, best.**

Shubham Shah and Sam Curry unlocked an automaker's cars from just a number plate.

The way in was an internet-facing admin tool called **TEST HARNESS**.

Even the best level leaves the app's own APIs public.

**Which level is your admin tool on? Save this.**
bullets: Good: WAF rules. An encoded URL got past.
Better: auth on every API. A leaked key undoes it.
Best: reachable only through a VPN.
